# Fact to source, drawn from the RDF graph (generated by `uv run python -m seisa_kg.rdf.provenance_view`)

The second visualisation (the first is Neo4j Bloom: `docs/images/`). Every box below is read from `data/output/graph.ttl` by SPARQL.
Read each arrow from the RDF-star note: the note **reifies** (points at) the fact, and says where the fact came from: **wasDerivedFrom** a source record (with its web address and fetch time), or **wasGeneratedBy** one of our rules (D-029).

## 1. A registry company: Bridgepoint Group plc (GLEIF and Companies House)

The same name is stated by GLEIF on two fetch dates, so that one fact has two notes (D-042). The status group and the GLEIF–Companies House link are our own judgements, so their notes point to a rule. A previous name carries its dates on its note.

flowchart LR
  af0["lei:213800KFNMVI8PDZX472<br/>ex:jurisdiction<br/>GB"]
  an1("RDF-star note")
  an1 -- reifies --> af0
  an1 -- prov:wasDerivedFrom --> as2
  as2[["src:gleif/213800KFNMVI8PDZX472/search-bridgepoint_p1/202610…<br/>url: https://api.gleif.org/api/v1/lei-records?filter%5…<br/>fetched: 2026-10-16"]]
  an3("RDF-star note")

  af5["lei:213800KFNMVI8PDZX472<br/>ex:legalName<br/>BRIDGEPOINT GROUP PLC"]
  an6("RDF-star note<br/>ex:language: en")
  an6 -- reifies --> af5
  an6 -- prov:wasDerivedFrom --> as2
  an7("RDF-star note<br/>ex:language: en")

  an7 -- prov:wasDerivedFrom --> as4
  af8["lei:213800KFNMVI8PDZX472<br/>ex:sameEntityAs<br/>ch:11443992"]
  an9("RDF-star note")
  an9 -- reifies --> af8
  an9 -- prov:wasGeneratedBy --> as10
  as10{{"ex:rule/D-025<br/>Link a GLEIF LEI to a Companies House number: reg…"}}
  af11["lei:213800KFNMVI8PDZX472<br/>ex:statusGroup<br/>ACTIVE"]
  an12("RDF-star note")
  an12 -- reifies --> af11
  an12 -- prov:wasGeneratedBy --> as13
  as13{{"ex:rule/D-092<br/>Map GLEIF and Companies House status words to one…"}}
  af14["ch:11443992<br/>ex:legalName<br/>BRIDGEPOINT GROUP PLC"]
  an15("RDF-star note")
  an15 -- reifies --> af14
  an15 -- prov:wasDerivedFrom --> as16
  as16[["src:ch/11443992/profile/20261019<br/>url: https://api.company-information.service.gov.uk/co…<br/>fetched: 2026-10-19"]]
  af17["ch:11443992<br/>ex:previousName<br/>ATLANTIC INVESTMENT HOLDINGS LIMITED"]

## 2. A news fact: Hg's OneStream deal

Each fact's note carries the exact quote and the model that extracted it; the note points to the sentence, the sentence to its release, and the release to the sponsor that published it.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  bf0["ex:deal/hg-06-d1<br/>ex:dealKind<br/>acquisition"]
  bn1("RDF-star note<br/>ex:extractedBy: gemini-2.5-pro<br/>ex:quote: acquired by Hg")
  bn1 -- reifies --> bf0
  bn1 -- prov:wasDerivedFrom --> bs2
  bs2[["src:news/hg-06/s03<br/>url: https://hgcapital.com/insights/onestream-to-be-ac…<br/>fetched: 2026-10-19<br/>text: BIRMINGHAM, Mich., January 6, 2026 – OneStream, I…"]]
  bs2 -- inRelease --> bs3
  bs3["ex:release/hg-06"]
  bs3 -- publishedBy --> bs4["ex:sponsor/hg"]
  bf5["ex:deal/hg-06-d1<br/>ex:dealStatus<br/>agreed"]
  bn6("RDF-star note<br/>ex:extractedBy: gemini-2.5-pro<br/>ex:quote: entered into a definitive agreement")
  bn6 -- reifies --> bf5
  bn6 -- prov:wasDerivedFrom --> bs2
  bf7["ex:deal/hg-06-d1<br/>ex:targetName<br/>OneStream, Inc."]
  bn8("RDF-star note<br/>ex:extractedBy: gemini-2.5-pro<br/>ex:quote: OneStream, Inc. (Nasdaq: OS) (“OneStrea…")
  bn8 -- reifies --> bf7
  bn8 -- prov:wasDerivedFrom --> bs2
```
